item.title: The tree room
item.description:
I started playing Deltarune a few weeks ago but only recently went deep into the lore of it (you don't need to know it to understand the post) and something weird happened to me.

I'm not a superstitious person and I wouldn't describe myself as paranoid, but at some point I was faced with the fact that something weird was happening around me.

Everything started when I learned about the tree room, which for those who don't know is an ironically famous secret room
